verdict.rationale: Credential management is a fair question for a package manager, since package-manager CLIs can create and manage scoped registry tokens. Nothing in the evidence shows Bun issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials. The pack covers installs, lockfiles, workspaces, audit and publish, but never token creation or permission scoping. Lifecycle-script trust controls (trustedDependencies) are an adjacent security feature, not credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
